trigger: No Stage-2 validation configuration of the lcc, size+anchor or sagflargest families met the overlap guard, so the pre-declared freeze stopped without writing a selection.
rule: A family without an eligible configuration is recorded under ineligible_families with its highest-MRER configuration and its guard deltas, and is not carried to the test split. The SAGF family must have an eligible configuration. Selection within eligible families is unchanged.
